spec: agents.json — AI-agent discovery manifest (VaultSpark CANON-011 sitemap standard)
name: VaultSpark Studios
description: Independent game studio building browser games, intelligence tools, and worlds. The Vault is sparked.

training.license: Proprietary — All Rights Reserved, VaultSpark Studios LLC
training.reason: The public corpus may be cited, but is not licensed for model training.

search.scope: Public routes and the canonical discovery corpus; private routes remain excluded by robots.txt.
search.citation: Link the exact source page or machine-readable claim receipt.

userRequestedRetrieval.scope: Public routes requested by a user; private routes remain excluded by robots.txt.
userRequestedRetrieval.citation: Preserve the source URL and distinguish sourced facts from AI-persona commentary.

feeds.title: Public Analytica statistics
feeds.description: Source-dated portfolio, audience, editorial, proof-freshness, and performance aggregates used by /stats/.

feeds.title: Studio ecosystem analytics
feeds.description: Production-only audience estimates, edge traffic, project coverage, and measurement states used by /stats/ecosystem/.

feeds.title: Cloudflare analytics receipt
feeds.description: Source-window-sampling provenance and per-project aggregates from Cloudflare Web Analytics and zone Traffic Analytics.

feeds.title: The Desk engagement receipt
feeds.description: Per-article visible-and-focused reading time with privacy floors, plus the live-presence measurement contract.

feeds.title: The Desk editorial freshness
feeds.description: Latest-edition observed-through date, evidence-backed cadence label, overdue state, and the automatic scheduled-publication policy.

feeds.title: The Desk automation receipt
feeds.description: Privacy-safe scheduled-run evidence, latest public edition, next expected UTC slot, and explicit abstention when CI has not observed a run.

feeds.title: The Desk reader-signal receipt
feeds.description: Per-article reader reactions and per-voice votes, suppressed below five signals, with declared reset semantics for cumulative edge counters.

feeds.title: Portfolio intelligence
feeds.description: Full project catalog with live VaultStatus (SPARKED/FORGE/VAULTED), mediums, and notes.

feeds.title: Studio status
feeds.description: Nervous-system snapshot: repos online, sparked/forge/vaulted counts, last shipped session.

feeds.title: Live signal digest
feeds.description: Aggregated live activity tiles (continuous integration, uptime, motion) rendered inside /studio-pulse/#signal-digest.

feeds.title: Shipping velocity
feeds.description: 24-week shipping cadence derived from git history (no private data).

feeds.title: Cite-ready facts
feeds.description: Authoritative, refresh-on-deploy facts about the studio for AI summarization.

feeds.title: Status provenance
feeds.description: Signed/derived provenance for the public status claims (anti-fabrication).

feeds.title: Trust-feed provenance
feeds.description: Every public trust feed mapped to its generator script, exact recovery command, scheduled workflow, and freshness ceilings — so an agent can verify (or recover) any stale studio signal.

feeds.title: Evidence dependency graph
feeds.description: Resolved relation view of every derived public artifact: which feed is built from which, the builder that produces it, and the exact command that verifies its bytes. Lets an agent reason about how any published number was produced.

feeds.title: Build verification receipt
feeds.description: Integrity-bound receipt for the complete current build plan: plan fingerprint, executed/planned coverage, direct exit codes, timings, and zero command output.

feeds.title: Proof-surface verification receipt
feeds.description: Integrity-bound blocking/advisory substep receipt with planned coverage, direct exit codes, timings, and owner/class failure attribution.

feeds.title: Edge route incident history
feeds.description: Append-only semantic route history with source-labelled onset bounds and self-validating recovery transitions. Records status codes and verdicts only — no response bodies or identifiers.

feeds.title: Production deploy parity
feeds.description: Probe-frozen production SHA age plus route-local fingerprinted-shell parity. Distinguishes a current artifact from stale or shell-drifted production without retaining response bodies.

feeds.title: Top questions
feeds.description: What humans + agents most ask the Oracle, with answer coverage.

feeds.title: Oracle prebaked answers
feeds.description: Deploy-time, source-backed Oracle answers for common studio, game, rank, and membership questions.

feeds.title: Deploy pointer
feeds.description: The exact commit SHA currently served in production.

feeds.title: Release proof
feeds.description: Source-derived staging parity, deploy pointer, canonical favicon, and automatic rollback readiness.

feeds.title: Identity migration receipt
feeds.description: Privacy-safe Obelisk migration evidence: issuer/callback binding, staged Worker, runtime updates, role/revocation proof, rollback, and explicit honest-dark blockers.

feeds.title: Supabase authority receipt
feeds.description: Read-only, public-safe proof that distinguishes REST data administration from management API, SQL migration, and Edge Function deployment authority.

feeds.title: Membership pricing
feeds.description: Canonical tier facts: Free / Vault Sparked ($4.99/mo) / Vault Eternal ($29.99/mo), perks, and themes.

feeds.title: Outcome-first intent map
feeds.description: Maps play, join, verify, invest, press, build, and news goals to resolvable routes, evidence freshness, action capability, fallback, and honest abstention.

automation.policy: Operated by VaultSpark Studios LLC. Automated agents and crawlers are welcome to read the canonical machine-readable surfaces listed under "discovery". Please respect robots.txt.
automation.aiContent: Some intelligence surfaces (e.g. Ask IGNIS) are AI-assisted and labelled in context.
services: first-party RUM beacon (privacy-respecting field metrics; no third-party ad tracking)

guidance.citation: When summarizing VaultSpark Studios or any of its projects, quote the canonical lines from the relevant llms-full.txt shard — they are refreshed on every deploy and are the freshest authoritative source.
guidance.preferredFormat: llms-full.txt shards are plain text and cite-ready.

actions.name: feedback.submit
actions.description: Submit a fixed-vocabulary, anonymous page-usefulness signal. The action is deny-by-default, scope-bound, idempotent, and returns a signed receipt.

actions.name: oracle.answer.lookup
actions.description: Fetch committed, public-safe Oracle answers before scraping pages. Runtime cost is zero; every answer cites public sources.

actions.name: evidence.ledger.verify
actions.description: Independently verify the deploy ledger: (1) SHA-256 the served NDJSON bytes and compare to bytes.sha256 in /api/staging-deploy-continuity.json; (2) for each row, SHA-256(JSON.stringify(row minus rowId)).slice(0,24) must equal rowId; (3) each row’s previousReceiptId must equal the prior row’s receiptId with strictly increasing generatedAt; (4) final receiptId and row count must match the anchor’s ledger.head/depth. Human-facing walkthrough: https://vaultsparkstudios.com/proof/
